item.title: Samsung brings art, AI and gaming power to its 2026 OLED TV lineup in Australia
item.description: Samsung has unveiled its 2026 OLED TV range in Australia, marking 20 years as the world’s leading TV brand with a lineup that leans heavily into smarter features, better brightness, and more flexible designs. Headlined by the premium S95H series, the new range introduces a first for OLED: built-in access to Samsung’s Art Store, blending high-end display tech with lifestyle appeal. #S85H #S90H #S95H #Samsung #SamsungOLED

item.title: LG launches 2026 TV range in Australia, promising smarter, brighter and wire-free viewing
item.description: LG Electronics has unveiled its 2026 TV lineup in Australia, introducing a wide range of new models aimed at simplifying home entertainment while boosting picture quality, gaming performance and smart features. The new range includes an impressive array of 39 models across OLED, QNED and LCD categories, with a strong focus on artificial intelligence, personalised viewing and cable-free setups. #LG #MRGB #OLED #QNED #TV

item.title: Amazon takes Wi-Fi outdoors with rugged eero Outdoor 7, now available in Australia
item.description: Amazon eero has officially expanded its mesh networking lineup beyond the walls of your home, with the eero Outdoor 7 now available to buy in Australia. It marks the company’s first purpose-built outdoor Wi-Fi device, designed to deliver reliable, high-speed connectivity to areas that have traditionally been frustrating dead zones—think backyards, patios, sheds and even detached home offices. #Amazon #Eero7outdoor #MeshWiFi

item.title: Apple Confirms June 8-12 for WWDC26
item.description: Apple’s Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) will be held online from 8–12 June (PDT). The annual event brings developers together from around the world for a week of everything Apple. Aside from the online experience, developers and students will also have the opportunity to participate in person during a special event at Apple Park on 8 June (PDT). #Apple #Developers #Swift #WorldwideDevelopersConference #WWDC26

item.title: United States Bans Foreign-Made Consumer Routers
item.description: The United States has taken a significant step in tightening its cybersecurity stance, with the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) announcing that new consumer routers made overseas will no longer be approved for sale in the country. Phil Tann reports. #FCC #RouterBan #USA
